system.name: agent-contracts
system.purpose: Maintains the Scyvera Agent Contract specification, the Python governance runtime, and the scyvera-ts conformance runtime, and publishes the TypeScript package to the public npm registry under human approval.

capabilities.name: publish_runtime_package
capabilities.description: Publishes @scyvera/scyvera-ts to the public npm registry from a release-triggered workflow, after the maintainer approves the deployment gate.

capabilities.name: verify_package_release
capabilities.description: Checks that the release tag matches the package version and that the runtime conforms to the pinned conformance suite before any artifact is published.

recovery.details: A failed run stops before publication. A bad published version is deprecated and superseded by a fixed patch; published versions are not unpublished.

replay.details: A published version is immutable, so the workflow is never replayed at the same version.
